description.value: The Golden & District Library is a branch of the Okanagan Regional Library, serving the Golden community in BC's Columbia Valley as part of one of Canada's larger regional library networks. It houses an ORL Makerspace equipped with an Audio Recording Studio, Creation Station, Digitization Stations, Video Recording Equipment, and a Cricut cutting machine. Free car parking is available both in front and behind the building, and a book drop bin is accessible on the exterior when the library is closed.
